title.zh: SkyAI, which holds over 2M $SOL($220M), appears to be dumping $SOL at a loss!
title.en: SkyAI, which holds over 2M $SOL($220M), appears to be dumping $SOL at a loss!

current_state.zh: On-chain data shows SkyAI, a holder of over 2M SOL (~$220M), has moved 568,000 SOL (~$63.87M) to exchanges in three days, apparently realizing a loss of roughly $46M against a ~$194 average entry.
